security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown backticks, relative documentation links, regex exec calls, and expected MP3 sound assets. The confirmed risks are credential handling, third-party TTS and Gemini use, external CLI execution, CDN script loading, and limited local filesystem discovery. No explicit prompt-injection text was found, but captured AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md artifacts create an untrusted-instructions risk that should be isolated.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to paste API keys into chat. Prefer OAuth, MCP authentication, or environment variables outside the project tree, and document redaction behavior.

remediation.issue: Captured visual data may be sent to Gemini or TTS providers
remediation.suggestion: Add an explicit privacy gate before cloud descriptions or external voice generation. State exactly which screenshots, text, or audio leave the machine and provide a local-only path.

remediation.issue: Captured AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files can be treated as instructions
remediation.suggestion: Store captured instruction-looking files as inert data, rename them with a safe extension, or keep them outside any directory where agents load project instructions.

remediation.issue: External command execution relies on npx and local scripts
remediation.suggestion: Pin the HyperFrames CLI version, avoid implicit package downloads, display commands before execution, and scope commands to the project directory where possible.

remediation.issue: Bundled MP3 assets lack provenance in the report
remediation.suggestion: Document source, license, and checksums for each bundled sound effect so reviewers can verify the binary assets across releases.

content.value_statement: Teams often need a short video that reflects a live website without starting from a blank brief. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through capture, storyboard, voiceover, animation, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Captures a website through HyperFrames and organizes screenshots, extracted text, design tokens, fonts, and assets.
Guides brief creation, storyboard planning, script writing, beat timing, captions, and narration choices.
Builds HyperFrames compositions with captured brand assets, CSS animation, GSAP motion, SFX, and optional voiceover.
Defines validation steps for linting, snapshots, contact-sheet review, accessibility warnings, and preview delivery.
Includes a verification script that checks required artifacts, brand visual usage, SFX timing, and beat duration consistency.
limitations: Requires the HyperFrames CLI and a local project structure.
External voice providers require user-owned API keys and may send text or audio to third-party services.
Captured screenshots and assets may contain sensitive content and need review before cloud description steps.
Delivers a preview by default and renders an MP4 only when the user explicitly asks.

use_cases.title: Create a Site Tour
use_cases.description: Turn a public homepage or documentation site into a short guided video that uses the site brand and real assets.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Product Walkthrough
use_cases.description: Create a narrated walkthrough plan with beats, visual direction, voiceover, captions, and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Validate a HyperFrames Build
use_cases.description: Check composition files, SFX timing, screenshots, captions, accessibility warnings, and preview readiness before handoff.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Site Tour
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a straightforward website video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use website-to-video for this URL: [URL]. Make a 20 second landscape site tour. Ask me only for missing strategy details.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Social Clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Short video for a social feed.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use website-to-video for [URL]. Create a 15 second portrait social clip with fast pacing, captions, and no full-screen product screenshots.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Narrated Walkthrough
prompt_templates.scenario: Detailed brief with voiceover and validation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use website-to-video for [URL]. Build a 35 second narrated walkthrough for [audience]. Include storyboard beats, voice direction, SFX notes, and validation evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Run Autonomous Production
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with clear autonomy and quality gates.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use website-to-video for [URL]. Decide the creative direction from the captured brand, produce the preview, run all required validation gates, and disclose anything not verified.

output_examples.input: A founder provides a homepage URL and asks for a 30 second product walkthrough.
output: A concise brief that locks the message, audience, duration, format, and narration plan.
A storyboard with beat concepts, asset choices, motion direction, SFX cues, and script lines.
A preview handoff with validation evidence and clear notes about any unverified areas.

output_examples.input: A marketing team asks for a 15 second website showcase for a social campaign.
output: A fast-paced beat plan that uses captured brand assets and avoids a slideshow of screenshots.
A HyperFrames build plan with captions, SFX, animated scenes, and platform-ready format choices.

output_examples.input: A video engineer asks whether a completed project is ready to preview.
output: A checklist covering lint, validation, screenshots, contact sheets, audio timing, motion review, and preview delivery.
A direct disclosure of what passed, what failed, and what still needs user spot-checking.

best_practices: Review captured assets before storyboarding so the video reflects the real website brand.
Use external TTS or Gemini steps only after confirming the user understands what data may leave the machine.
Run the validation and preview gates before claiming the video is ready.
anti_patterns: Do not turn captured screenshots into a simple slideshow.
Do not ask users to paste API keys into chat when safer credential setup is available.
Do not skip contact-sheet review, lint output, or honest disclosure in autonomous mode.

faq.question: Does this skill render the final MP4 automatically?
faq.answer: No. It delivers a preview by default and renders only when the user explicitly asks for export.

faq.question: Can it work without paid TTS providers?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports a local Kokoro voice path, though quality may be lower than HeyGen or ElevenLabs voices.

faq.question: Does it upload captured website images?
faq.answer: It can use Gemini descriptions during capture or snapshot review. The user should approve cloud analysis before using that path.

faq.question: What makes this different from a screenshot video?
faq.answer: It plans composed animated beats, uses captured brand assets selectively, and validates motion, timing, and visual quality.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should users prepare before starting?
faq.answer: Users should provide the URL, target audience, desired duration, format, key message, and any privacy limits for captured content.
